text: Push, SMS, email · 10M+/day · retries and preferences
originalText: Push, SMS, email · 10M+/day · retries and preferences

text:
Key decisions
- One queue per channel (isolation)
- Retry with backoff, then DLQ
- Idempotency key: no duplicates
- Respect opt-out + quiet hours
- Track sent / delivered / opened
